name: Model Accordion
description: Provider accordion, pinned favorites, sort and expand/collapse toolbar for the chat model selector, plus a local OpenAI-compatible gateway importer (WorkBuddy/Trae/...). DOM-decoration only — model selection stays with the host.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 模型选择器增强：单开手风琴、收藏置顶、排序与全收全展工具栏、状态记忆，并可一键发现本机 WorkBuddy/Trae 等本地 OpenAI 兼容网关导入成 provider。只装饰 DOM，模型选择仍由宿主负责。
